List the CRAN releases of a package

Source: R/pkg_history.R
pkg_versions.Rd

Return every version of a package published on CRAN, with its release date, sorted by version number (oldest first). Use it to choose versions for pkg_history() or for "cran::pkg@version" specifications.

Usage

pkg_versions(package)

Arguments

package

Name of a CRAN package, such as "dplyr". A "cran::" prefix is accepted.

Value

A tibble with one row per release and columns package, version, date (a Date) and current (TRUE for the release currently on CRAN). Archived packages have no current release.

Details

Dates are those recorded by CRAN: the file date in CRAN's archive for older releases, and the Date/Publication field for the current one. A date is NA if CRAN does not report it.

See also

pkg_history() to analyse several releases.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
pkg_versions("desc")
}
